name: Hau-plum harvest festival
nameVi: Ngày hội hái quả mận hậu Mộc Châu
summary: The 10th hau-plum harvest was 23–24 May 2026 at Na Ka, in phường Thảo Nguyên. Pickers work by hand. Dan Viet said they were not to shake the tree or break branches. The next ripe week is check on arrival.
when: 23–24 May 2026 at Na Ka. The next year is check on arrival.
